approval_scope: Bounded collection of new production traces and verification of actual successful command output/execute coverage, with separately reported final behavior and Strict results. Not certification that immutable tests/helper remained untouched at every historical instant or adversarial anti-tamper security.

residual_contract_gaps.finding: Only final workspace hashes prove immutable helper/test identity. The bound events are action_finished results and the private checker selects command results; it never checks intervening action mutations or trusted pre-command helper/test hashes. A temporary helper/test replacement followed by command execution and restoration is not rejected by these predicates, although the public contract forbids modifying them. Exact stdout binding proves what a command printed, not which helper/test bytes generated it.
residual_contract_gaps.required_fix: Bind trusted per-command immutable file identity or reject history mutations to protected helper/tests and test configuration (including command workspace deltas), with a restored-after-tamper mutant. Do not weaken the public contract silently.

scope_clarification: After reporting the historical-identity gap, parent clarified the round makes no full-history hostile-project tamper-proof claim and will keep that limit explicit. Under that limited claim, collecting frozen production traces need not wait for expanded security instrumentation. The identified gap remains a limitation of interpreting Strict as proof of full process compliance.
collection_conditions: Freeze these exact task/acceptance/binding bytes before model run and retain immutable event evidence.
